about: cpu1bit timed session (plans/cpu-benchmark-mac.md). Copy, fill the tune-* grids, the size-tune roster and CANDIDATE, freeze. Stage order: validate -> p-isa -> size-tune -> tune-* -> gapcheck -> size-8t-i8x2, size-4t-i8x2, size-8t-i8x3, size-4t-i8x3 -> screen, screen-4t, screen-i8x3, screen-4t-i8x3 -> confirm. Each sizing stage writes a write-once N per clip (12 s / (0.95 x the fastest roster arm)); confirm uses the primary condition's N. Condition matrix {8, 4 workers} x {i8x2, i8x3} complete; B1T-MB1 measured in every screening condition.

p-isa.about: P's instruction-throughput probe (p-ubench --qos-ui isa) at QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE in the quiet window; one-off, non-comparison, recorded like validate; QoS readback, child darwin-background state and placement evidence gated (c2 finding 4)

qos_readback.source: p_bitserial/src/bin/p_ubench.rs qos_line(), printed after ThreadPool::new(1, Qos::UserInteractive)

size-tune.about: N for the tuning grids and the gap check (add the tune-v/t/p grid arms before running); one block per arm, one replay per clip

tune-bneon.about: B-NEON frozen tuning grid (M7): 6 points, MB1 derived export, primary condition; pick = lowest median over clips of per-clip mean E_est per replay (ties: latency, name); summarize.py

tune-v.about: V's frozen 6-point grid: fill arms with one entry per grid point (binary replay-v-sdot, MB1 export, tuning JSON) before the stage runs

gapcheck.about: M7: B-NEON at the picked point vs the pre-expanded SDOT control (same tuning); gap = (B-NEON - control) / control, latency and energy; > 25% blocks the freeze until explained

size-8t-i8x2.about: N for every stage of this condition (screen and, for the primary, confirm)

size-4t-i8x2.about: N for every stage of this condition (screen and, for the primary, confirm)

size-8t-i8x3.about: N for every stage of this condition (screen and, for the primary, confirm)

size-4t-i8x3.about: N for every stage of this condition (screen and, for the primary, confirm)

screen.about: Williams R=1 over the frozen roster; candidates V, T, P; R-M1 (drift-free M1 reference) and B1T-MB1 (B-NEON 1-bit tile, isolates storage) are descriptive arms, never confirmation candidates. analysis.py screen --baseline R-MB1 --candidates V,T,P; primary condition (8 workers, i8x2)

screen-4t.about: Williams R=1 over the frozen roster; candidates V, T, P; R-M1 (drift-free M1 reference) and B1T-MB1 (B-NEON 1-bit tile, isolates storage) are descriptive arms, never confirmation candidates. analysis.py screen --baseline R-MB1 --candidates V,T,P; descriptive: 4 workers, i8x2

confirm.about: R=6 Williams for k=2 against R-MB1; set CANDIDATE from analysis.py screen; analysis.py confirm --screen <screen dir>
